# ffxf_vpc_member (Resource)

Connects a virtual machine to a private network. Changing vpc_id moves the member to the target network in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    ffxf = {
      source = "ffxfnet/ffxf"
    }
  }
}

provider "ffxf" {}

resource "ffxf_vpc_member" "web" {
  vpc_id = 12
  vm_id  = 34
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vm_id` (Number) Virtual machine identifier.
- `vpc_id` (Number) Private network identifier.

### Read-Only

- `configuration` (String) Network configuration mode, automatic or manual.
- `hostname` (String) Virtual machine hostname.
- `id` (String) Stable identifier composed of the VPC and VM identifiers.
- `ip` (String) Private IP address assigned by the network.
